name: smwsprites-sprite-door
title: Sprite Door
description:
A highly customisable sprite door. Using extra bytes, it can have gravity and object interaction, use any palette you want, be closed and/or be only enterable when a blue P-switch is active. If the extra bit is clear, it will use the current screen exit. If it is set, it will use an exit specified by extra byte 2 and 3.
See .asm file for details / further customisation.

⚠ Be aware that since it uses one of the default sprite clippings, its hitbox is a little different from a regular door's.

Special thanks to mario90 and Atari2.0 for helping with the teleport code :)
